notes: The county page has only a short note. Ask about pay, age and how to apply by email in March or April.
name: Fairfax County IT Internship for High Schoolers
org: Fairfax County Department of Information Technology
what_you_do: Summer internship with the county IT department. The county page gives no task list.
who_can_apply: High school students in Fairfax County.
duration: Mid-June until a week before school starts
deadline_text: Recruitment generally starts in April. No 2027 dates posted.
how_to_apply: Email DITHR@fairfaxcounty.gov to ask how to apply.
